summary: State-dependent dispatcher. Selects a mode with ShortComputation_6720(this) and switches on its result using the jump table jpt_48726F. Each case conditionally forwards the boolean a2 (checked state) through the object's vtable slot +0x40 as an integer parameter: case 0 passes 1 when a2 set, case 1 passes 0 when a2 clear, case 2 passes 3 when a2 set, case 3 passes 2 when a2 clear. Case 4 first reads a byte field via ByteFieldGetterAt100; when that is zero it branches on RangeCheck to pass either (a2 != 0) or (a2 != 0) + 2. Default returns the selector unchanged.

local_names.a2: boolean checked-state argument forwarded into the vtable parameter
local_names.v2: mode selector from ShortComputation_6720; also the value returned
local_names.v3: register-held object pointer whose vtable slot +0x40 is dispatched (uninitialized in decompilation)
local_names.v4: zero flag from comparing RangeCheck result against 0
local_names.v5: register-held pointer used in case 4 dispatch (uninitialized in decompilation)
local_names.v7: BOOL form of a2 used as case-4 vtable parameter base

operations.description: v2 = ShortComputation_6720(this): compute the widget mode/state used as the switch selector
Switch on v2 via jump table jpt_48726F with cases 0, 1, 2, 3, 4 and a default
Case 0: execute only when a2 is non-zero
Case 0: call vtable slot +0x40 on v3 with literal parameter 1
Case 1: execute only when a2 is zero
Case 1: call vtable slot +0x40 on v3 with literal parameter 0
Case 2: execute only when a2 is non-zero
Case 2: call vtable slot +0x40 on v3 with literal parameter 3
Case 3: execute only when a2 is zero
Case 3: call vtable slot +0x40 on v3 with literal parameter 2
Case 4: read the byte field at the object via ByteFieldGetterAt100(v3)
Case 4: continue only when the ByteFieldGetterAt100 result is zero
Case 4: RangeCheck() determines which sub-branch to take (result compared to zero)
Case 4: when RangeCheck returned zero, dispatch with parameter (a2 != 0); otherwise dispatch with parameter (a2 != 0) + 2
Case 4: call vtable slot +0x40 on v5 with the selected parameter
Default case returns v2 unchanged; all other cases fall through to return v2 (the parameter passed to the vtable call is captured in LOBYTE(v2))

unresolved: v3 and v5 are register-held object pointers left uninitialized by the decompiler; their identity and the concrete class behind vtable slot +0x40 are unknown
The vtable slot +0x40 target and the semantics of parameters 0-3 are not identified by the packet
Purpose of the RangeCheck branch in case 4 (parameter + 2) is undocumented
jpt_48726F is referenced as the switch jump table but its contents are not part of the packet
